organization: Raynor Door Company (Chicago-area Raynor dealer, Northfield)
title: How Much Does Garage Door Repair Cost in Chicago?
claim: Chicago-area typical installed prices: most residential repairs $150-500; torsion spring $200-400; extension spring $150-300; cable $150-250; rollers $100-200; off-track realignment $125-250; opener repair $100-250; opener replacement installed $250-600; panel/section $250-800.
excerpt: most residential garage door repairs land between $150 and $500, including parts and labor costs
limitations: Dealer marketing guide ('typical ranges'), not transaction data; one firm; opener range likely reflects entry chain-drive units.
